prt_porto_s_o_bento_azulejo_panels.webp.note: Image 1 is the station's exterior, not an azulejo panel. Image 2 is a generic AI-looking tile scene with surrounding cornice and wall, not the original artwork.

fra_mona_lisa.webp.note: Image 2 is an AI-style recreation; the original's aspect ratio was extended with invented landscape and sleeve areas, and details such as the crackle texture and fine features differ.

nld_girl_with_a_pearl_earring.webp.note: Background extended with dark fill; the turban's blue band shows blocky, pixelated brushwork, and the craquelure is smoother than in the original.

usa_the_starry_night.webp.note: Composition is stretched vertically from 5:4 to square, so the elements look elongated. The brushwork is also more uniform and digital-looking than the original.

ita_the_last_supper.webp.note: Figures are redrawn, not the original. Added lunettes with coats of arms on top and a tiled floor below. The original's doorway cutout is gone.

ita_the_birth_of_venus.webp.note: Composition matches, but the square was made by AI-extending the sea at the bottom and sky at the top; the reeds and shoreline are altered and the added area looks different from the original.

vat_the_creation_of_adam.webp.note: Image 2 is an outpainted extension: invented sky above and foreground below, and the right side crops God's figure and the cherubs. The extended areas look smudged.

aut_the_kiss.webp.note: Looks like an AI-style recreation: faces, patterns, flowers and details differ (woman's face, robe motifs, flower meadow). Signature is garbled, not Klimt's.

deu_wanderer_above_the_sea_of_fog.webp.note: Composition differs: the mountains, rock formations, sky and figure's pose and placement are altered, and the colours are warmer. It is a reinterpretation, not the original.

vat_school_of_athens.webp.note: Looks like an AI re-creation: figures differ in pose and placement, the lower floor is extended and the arch is cropped, so the composition does not match.

gbr_sunflowers.webp.note: Image 2 is a different Sunflowers version (yellow background, fifteen flowers, round vase); image 1 has a blue-green background, twelve flowers and a 'Vincent' signature on the vase.

usa_irises.webp.note: Upper background was repainted as a yellow-orange swirl instead of the original green foliage, and the iris arrangement is slightly altered. This is a variation, not the same work.

nld_caf_terrace_at_night.webp.note: Looks like an AI-generated imitation: the stars have swirling halos, the figures on the right are missing, and the details differ from the original.

bel_the_fall_of_icarus.webp.note: Composition altered: the plowman, horse, sheep and shepherd are rearranged; the shepherd looking up is missing; the foreground is extended with generated, muddy dark areas.

gbr_the_hay_wain.webp.note: Different composition: white horse, haystack load, willow tree, smoke from chimney, and extra figures at the cottage. This is a reinterpretation, not the original.

gbr_happy_accident_on_the_swing.webp.note: Composition altered: figures repositioned, the man on the right is shown differently with a visible face, the dog and background are changed, and the colours are warmer. This is a repainted variant, not the original.

usa_luncheon_of_the_boating_party.webp.note: Looks like an AI regeneration: faces, poses, and details differ, and the brushwork is changed. Figures are rearranged and the signature is altered.

esp_the_third_of_may_1808.webp.note: Figures are redrawn: faces, poses and the soldiers' uniforms differ. The sky and ground were extended, so this is a regenerated approximation rather than the same painting.

pol_lady_with_an_ermine.webp.note: Image 2 is the same painting, extended on the dark background to fill the square with no visible seam. The original's top-left inscription is removed.

fra_olympia.webp.note: Composition altered: cat posture/position differs, bed and figures rearranged, extended dark areas added, bouquet and colours differ; looks like an AI-generated outpainted variant.

usa_the_great_wave_of_kanagawa.webp.note: Composition is similar but redrawn: sky is yellow with added clouds, waves and boats differ in detail, and the colour scheme is altered.

nld_almond_blossom.webp.note: Colours are much more saturated turquoise than the original's muted blue-green. Branches and blossoms are redrawn differently, so this is a regenerated variant.

can_massacre_of_the_innocents.webp.note: Composition differs: the buildings, figures, horses and layout are rearranged, with new infant corpses on the ice. It looks like a different AI-generated painting.

nor_the_scream.webp.note: Colours differ (blue/green water vs dark original); the two background figures are redrawn and look different; the foreground figure's form is altered; the right-edge red strip is missing.

usa_american_gothic.webp.note: Looks like an AI-regenerated version: faces, house, trees and porch differ. Left side extended with new yard. Original signature and date missing.

usa_a_sunday_afternoon_on_the_island_of_.note: Figures are redrawn and rearranged: the pipe smoker, the monkey's position, and the hats and faces differ. The left woman's parasol and the standing couple are altered. It reads as a regenerated imitation, not the original.

fra_self_portrait.webp.note: Image 2 shows a different painting: an older man with clasped hands, brown coat and lighter lighting, versus a young man with open mouth, dark beret and gorget.

fra_the_bridge_at_narni.webp.note: Different composition: hilltop town, a figure with a donkey and a second arch are invented; the original's bridge, river and hills are rearranged.

fra_the_starry_night_over_the_rhone.webp.note: Regenerated look: stars, lights, boats and reflections differ in count and placement; sky is more uniform and brighter, with a different horizon and shoreline.

usa_dogs_playing_poker.webp.note: Different composition: a round table under a lamp in a dim room, not the train carriage with a conductor. The dogs, poses and colours differ.

fra_arrangement_in_grey_and_black_no_1.w.note: Image 2 is a mirrored, regenerated imitation: the curtain moved from left to right and changed from dark floral to pale, the picture on the wall differs, and the figure's face and details are altered.

esp_the_garden_of_earthly_delights.webp.note: Composition is regenerated, not the original: figures and objects are rearranged, with extra strawberries and figures at the bottom. Panels are stretched and show gaps.

gbr_the_ambassadors.webp.note: A crucifix with a Christ figure was added at upper left, and the table instruments look altered or regenerated rather than faithfully reproduced.

usa_the_night_caf.webp.note: Looks like an AI reimagining: rearranged figures, doorway, clock and lamps; green ceiling added; figures reseated; original signature absent; extra figure in doorway.

fra_impression_sunrise.webp.note: Colours shifted to blue/lavender; sky brushwork and boats redrawn, extended areas invented; signature garbled and altered; sun and reflection differ. Not a faithful reproduction.

gbr_the_fighting_temeraire.webp.note: Image 2 is a regenerated version, not the original: the sky is bluer, the ship is larger and more detailed, and the sun and buoy are repositioned. The extended sky and sea look AI-made.

pri_flaming_june.webp.note: Sky was regenerated with a warmer pink tone, and the pole at top right is altered into duplicated crossed poles, so the extension doesn't faithfully match the original.

usa_saint_george_and_the_dragon.webp.note: Composition mirrored; knight has red plume, flowers, mountain with tiny buildings and swirling sky added; palette differs. A different painting, not a reproduction.

ita_annunciation.webp.note: Composition is extended: new sky above, and the garden and floor are enlarged. The building is also altered, with the dark door and the right side changed, so it is not a natural crop.

usa_breezing_up.webp.note: Different composition: boat is white with different crew and sail, an island is added, and the 'GLOUCESTER' lettering and signature are missing. It looks like a new painting, not a reproduction.

gbr_the_ladies_waldegrave.webp.note: Different composition: hairstyles, poses, props, background and colours differ (brown hair vs powdered grey wigs, no window, different table). It is a lookalike, not a reproduction.

fra_et_in_arcadia_ego.webp.note: Different composition: figures are in the foreground leaning over a stone slab, with no tree trunk or owl and no inscription. The skull is placed differently. It is a reinterpretation, not the same painting.

usa_the_avenue_in_the_rain.webp.note: Different composition: symmetrical street with cars, many figures and receding buildings; original has large central flags and few umbrella figures. Colors and technique differ.

fra_madame_recamier.webp.note: Composition mirrored (figure faces right, lamp moved right); pose, cushions, and headband differ; lamp has added flame; this is a regenerated imitation, not the original.

fra_patrocles.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: a mourning scene with many soldiers, a funeral pyre and a sea, instead of a single seated nude seen from behind.

fra_napoleon_crossing_the_alps.webp.note: Colour scheme changed: horse is brown not white-grey, cape is ochre not red. Inscriptions garbled. Composition is similar but it is a recreation.

ita_narcissus.webp.note: Original was extended with generated dark areas on the sides to reach 1:1; the figure is shrunk and the hands no longer touch the edges, so the extension is noticeable.

usa_the_sleeping_gypsy.webp.note: Looks like an AI-made reinterpretation, not the original. The lion, figure, mandolin and jug are redrawn and rearranged, and the stars and moon differ. The signature is missing.

fra_the_gleaners.webp.note: Composition is similar but the colours are much more golden/yellow, the background figures and horseman are repositioned and enlarged, and the figures' poses and details are altered. It's a repainted variant.

ita_primavera.webp.note: Bottom area was extended with generated flower field showing a visible seam near y≈850; figures appear stretched vertically and the composition differs slightly from the original.

nld_wheatfield_with_crows.webp.note: Sky is much darker and more dramatic, crow placement differs, path and field shapes are altered; this is a re-rendering, not the original composition.

aut_the_tower_of_babel.webp.note: Image 2 is a re-imagined variant: the tower's shape, figures, king group, ships, terrain and clouds differ from Bruegel's original composition.

fra_a_cotton_office_in_new_orleans.webp.note: Different composition: figures, furniture, windows and layout are rearranged. It looks like a new AI-generated scene, not Degas's painting, and adds ledgers and desks.

gbr_bacchus_and_ariadne.webp.note: Different composition: Bacchus pose, figures, and chariot rearranged; goats/donkey added, stars changed to a circle, Ariadne's pose differs. Not Titian's original.

usa_the_gross_clinic.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: the figures are rearranged, the woman is no longer in the same place, the colours are darker, and the signature is missing. It is a regenerated imitation, not the original.

fra_the_astronomer.webp.note: Looks like an AI-regenerated imitation: the globe, window, robe color (green vs blue-gray), carpet pattern, clock/cabinet details and chair all differ. Fills the square with no border.

usa_paris_street_in_rainy_weather.webp.note: Image 2 is a re-rendering: buildings, lamppost, and figures are rearranged; a man carrying a bundle is added, and the signature is missing.

fra_water_lilies.webp.note: Different composition: image 2 shows a sky reflection with many small lilies, while the original is a close-up with few large pads and two pink blooms.

che_composition_with_red_blue_and_yellow.note: Bottom-right differs: original has small white square and black bar above yellow; reproduction shows only yellow. Line proportions also differ, so it is a different composition.

are_salvator_mundi.webp.note: Image 2 differs from the original: the sphere is dark and opaque, the hand and orb are cropped differently, and the colours and details are altered. It looks like a re-rendering.

usa_the_peaceable_kingdom.webp.note: Different composition: animals rearranged, bear added, child's clothing differs, treaty scene and ship missing; new figures on the right bank. Not the Hicks original.

rus_the_ninth_wave.webp.note: Colour scheme differs strongly (fiery orange vs. pale yellow-pink), and the raft and figures are rearranged and fewer, so it is not the same rendering.

gbr_mr_and_mrs_andrews.webp.note: Recreation, not the original: the sky is brighter, the figures are posed and placed differently, the bench and wheat sheaves are changed, a church is added, and a signature appears bottom left.

usa_pollice_verso.webp.note: Different composition: the original's emperor's box, hanging carpets, second fallen gladiator and standing pose are changed or missing. Looks like an AI reinterpretation with many new spectators.

fra_the_embarkation_to_cythera.webp.note: Different composition: statue moved left, boat with canopy added, figures rearranged, cherubs relocated. It's a reinterpretation, not a reproduction of Watteau's painting.

gbr_a_bar_at_the_folies_berg_re.webp.note: Composition altered: figures and bottles shifted, man at right cropped, bar extended with generated marble; details differ, so it is a regeneration, not the original.

gbr_the_laughing_cavalier.webp.note: Different painting: pose is mirrored with hand on hip, the collar is smaller, the costume embroidery differs, and the hat is tilted differently. It is a lookalike, not a reproduction.

deu_the_fox.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: a single curled sleeping fox on blue/green/yellow facets, not Marc's two red foxes. Colour scheme differs.

gbr_the_lady_of_shalott.webp.note: Image 2 extends the original downward with generated water and lily pads, and the left and right edges are cropped. The extension is a plausible match, but the added area changes the composition.

fra_the_card_players.webp.note: Image 2 is a different version: the figures are posed and scaled differently, the cards are held higher, the colours are muted, and the background is rearranged. The extended areas look like repainted additions.

usa_the_grand_canal_venice.webp.note: Different composition: the Salute dome is centered, Gothic palazzo on left, no portico on right, different boats and figures. A signature is added at bottom right.

gbr_a_boat_passing_a_lock.webp.note: Different composition: boat centered, cottage, white horse, bridge added; original's lock gates, dog, stormy sky, and figure missing. Signature-like mark bottom left.

ita_sacred_and_profane_love.webp.note: Looks like a reinterpretation, not Titian's painting. Figures, poses and details differ: a winged cupid, a flaming lamp, a rider, sheep and a fountain spout are added or changed.

gbr_the_ancient_of_days.webp.note: Looks like an AI reinterpretation, not the original. The figure's face, pose, hair, sun, clouds, compass and colours are redrawn, with a different technique.

mlt_the_beheading_of_saint_john_the_bapt.note: Different composition: figures rearranged, seated robed man added, executioner posed differently, bound victim reversed, prisoners differ. It is a reinterpretation, not the original.

rus_the_return_of_the_prodigal_son.webp.note: Figures are repainted and rearranged: the two background figures (upper left, and the smiling one behind) are missing or replaced by a mask-like face. Details and proportions differ.

usa_christ_carrying_the_cross.webp.note: Faces and details differ (e.g. top-left man's open mouth, the central grotesque figure, the woman's face); looks like a reinterpretation or different version, not the original.

ita_deposition_from_the_cross.webp.note: Different composition: figures, poses, ladders, and colours differ from Rosso Fiorentino's original. Looks like a new AI-generated painting, not a reproduction.

fra_the_luncheon_on_the_grass.webp.note: Image 1 is a charcoal sketch on grey paper with a different composition and figure placement; image 2 is Monet's finished color painting.

fra_dance_at_le_moulin_de_la_galette.web.note: Different composition: figures, dancers, table and chairs are rearranged; it is a new AI-style imitation, not Renoir's painting. Added new figures.

ita_the_calling_of_st_matthew.webp.note: Composition is altered: figures are repositioned, the Christ figure is changed, and the colour is warmer. The extended area looks stretched or regenerated, not original.

fra_grande_odalisque.webp.note: Different composition: figure lies prone facing away on pillows, holding a peacock fan; hookah, curtains and colours are rearranged. It is a new image, not a reproduction.

rus_dance_ii.webp.note: Image 2 is a regenerated version: the figures are smoother and more naturalistic, the hair and faces differ, and the green is brighter. The extended hill and sky are invented, not original.

nld_the_milkmaid.webp.note: Looks like an AI-regenerated imitation: details differ (bread, tiles, basket, jug, wall texture), and the right side is extended with invented wall and floor.

fra_the_thinker.webp.note: Sculpture is the same, shown from a different angle and setting (garden, not the original's office-building backdrop). Pedestal differs, but no seams or distortion.

fra_venus_de_milo.webp.note: Image 2 is a regenerated look-alike: the head turn, drapery folds, arm stumps, base and warm tone differ from the original. The studio background suits a sculpture.

vat_piet.webp.note: Sculpture, not a painting; background changed from marble wall to dark blue niche, plinth altered, but the artwork is intact and unstretched.

deu_nefertiti_bust.webp.note: Image 2 is a frontal, AI-like recreation. Both eyes are inlaid, though the original has only one, and the details differ. The gray studio background means it is not a faithful reproduction.

ita_ecstasy_of_saint_teresa.webp.note: Surrounding marble is reddish-brown and black, unlike the original's green; the arrow is missing, the rays are altered, and the architecture is invented.

usa_composition_viii.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: shapes, lines and colours are rearranged (pink/olive circles, blue triangle, squiggle), so it is an imitation rather than a faithful reproduction.

ita_apollo_and_daphne.webp.note: Image 2 is an AI-style reinterpretation: poses, arm positions, drapery and tree differ from Bernini's original. A plain studio backdrop replaces the museum interior.

ita_discobolus.webp.note: Image 2 is a re-rendering, not the original: different head and face, simplified base and tree stump, altered anatomy and proportions, different background.

fra_psyche_revived_by_cupid_s_kiss.webp.note: Image 2 looks like an AI-generated re-creation, not the original. Poses, faces, wing angles and drapery differ, and Psyche's head and Cupid's legs are altered.
